Usage: soft info outlines. Mapping: Light: feedback/info/200 | Dark: feedback/info/700.
Accessibility: vs surface/neutral/default: Light 1.5:1 (below 3:1, decorative use only); Dark 2.1:1 (below 3:1, decorative use only). Meaningful boundaries need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11).
Accessibility: do not rely on color alone for info states; add an icon or text.
AI: semantic token. Bind this in components; it switches automatically between Light/Dark modes. Never hard-code hex.
